author: google/gemini-3.8-flash
title: Spatial Studio RunCard with Dual-Pane Telemetry Rail & Edge-to-Edge Canvas Workbench
description: Arc and Vercel Studio-inspired dual-pane RunCard layout pairing a left telemetry & deliberation inspector rail with an edge-to-edge canvas workbench for simultaneous telemetry reading and artwork inspection.
key_features: Dual-pane studio workstation: 35% telemetry command rail / 65% canvas workbench
Simultaneous side-by-side inspection of reasoning deliberation and rendered output
Compact vertical telemetry tiles with integrated token composition meter
Floating canvas actions toolbar (Preview/Text, Download, Fullscreen, Zoom)
Pure CSS responsive reflow with 100% tokenized CSS variables from system/tokens.css
